Hardware reporting with the source, date and uncertainty visible.

Reporting standards

We separate company announcements, independently tested results and our own analysis. A source update first enters a review queue. It does not become a published story or receive a new publication date automatically.

No dated news report is published in this prepared release. The resources below are completed explainers, rather than breaking-news claims.

USB-C does not tell you the speed: a port and cable checklist

Separate connector shape, data speed, charging and video support before buying a cable, hub or display.

Local AI memory: model weights are only the starting point

Estimate weight storage, then budget explicitly for the runtime and KV cache without claiming that a model will fit or run quickly.

Memory market watch: AI demand is not a price quote for your RAM

Separate company reporting, server-memory products and the delivered price of an exact desktop memory kit.
